description: Render a chart to an SVG or PNG file, offline. Either give a simple description ({ type: bar|line|area|pie|scatter, data: rows, x, y, color?, title? }; y may be a list of fields for multi-series line/bar charts), or a full Vega-Lite (or Vega) spec in "spec" with the rows inline in data.values. Field types are inferred (numbers = quantitative, ISO dates = temporal, other = categories). Loading data or images from URLs or files is refused. Up to 50,000 rows. PNG is rasterised from the SVG at "scale" (default 2×).

background.description: Background colour. Default white; "transparent" for none.

color.description: Optional field that splits the data into coloured series.

data.description: Rows for the simple chart, e.g. [{"month":"Jan","sales":12}].

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

scale.description: PNG only: pixel density multiplier (2 = twice the SVG size, sharp on high-DPI screens). Default 2.

spec.description: A full Vega-Lite spec (or Vega, if its $schema says so). Data must be inline (data.values). Use this or "type".

type.description: Simple chart type. Use with data, x and y.

x.description: Field for the x axis (the category / slice label for pie).

y.description: Numeric field for the y axis (slice size for pie). A list of fields draws one series per field.

name: ai_chart
title: Chart to SVG/PNG
